subject: [hw] DONE V11 rev 3 (test count correction: 959/959)
body:
Rev 3 is a test-only correction on top of rev 2: I added three more must-be-UNDEF cases while checking the 32-bit accumulators (SMLALD/SMLSLD with RdHi == RdLo, RdHi = PC, RdLo = PC), so the pass line is now:

    $ bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v11/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V11 PASS 959/959
    N2TEST V11 PASS 959/959

The rev 2 message said 956/956; this supersedes it. Implementation unchanged since rev 2 (SMUSDX order fix + SMULxy/SMULWy fixed-field rejection). STATUS files updated with the 959 count and the three UNDEF cases. Still available for review findings.
